title: Hi, I'm $t(common:site.displayName)
description: Software engineering master's student, passionate about open source and technical sharing.
I hope to do research rooted in real problems and focused on practical value.
I also aim to become an engineer who solves real problems and delivers excellent experiences.
Not satisfied with merely finishing tasks, but turning experience into understanding through inquiry.

values.title: From goals to delivery
values.description: I learn what the work requires, plan the next steps, assess options in context, and work through problems. I share ideas at key points and refine the approach, keeping the work moving toward reliable results.

values.title: Go deeper, see further
values.description: I look beyond what happens to understand why. Strong fundamentals help me ask deeper questions, and those questions strengthen my understanding, helping me spot problems that might otherwise go unnoticed.

values.title: Judgment and balance
values.description: I explore ways to work with AI and understand its capabilities and limits. I weigh efficiency and quality according to the task, and also look for ways to work more efficiently while meeting quality requirements, retaining my own judgment.
